scientific_limitations_and_integrity.not_claimed: No global convexity, uniqueness, or unimodality result for spatially varying controls or mixed-mode data.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proved: Exact necessary-and-sufficient strict-convexity threshold and uniqueness of the global minimizer for every positive regularization parameter in the stated restricted model.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.residual_risk: A notation-different prior treatment of this exact one-mode threshold may not have been recovered by the searches.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Constant scalar controls and source/target aligned with one normalized eigenfunction of a positive self-adjoint fractional elliptic operator.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.verification: Analytic proof plus a reproducible rational-arithmetic example; the example is illustrative, not the proof.

title: Sharp convexity threshold and unimodality for a single-mode bilinear-control benchmark
